description: JavaScript source file for the Products module in vtiger CRM, containing functions for UI interactions, form validation, and data handling related to products.

methods.name: updateListPrice
methods.description: Updates the visibility and value of a list price field based on a checkbox.

methods.name: check4null
methods.description: Validates that the product name field is not empty before form submission.

methods.name: set_return
methods.description: Sets product info in the parent window for selection.

methods.name: set_return_specific
methods.description: Sets product info in specific detail view or edit window.

methods.name: set_return_formname_specific
methods.description: Sets product info in a specified form in the parent window.

methods.name: add_data_to_relatedlist
methods.description: Adds related product data via URL redirection.

methods.name: set_return_inventory
methods.description: Populates inventory form fields in the parent window with product data.

methods.name: set_return_inventory_po
methods.description: Populates purchase order inventory form fields with product data.

methods.name: set_return_product
methods.description: Sets product info in the parent window for selection.

methods.name: getImageListBody
methods.description: Retrieves the image list DOM element based on browser type.

methods.name: roundPriceValue
methods.description: Rounds a numeric value to two decimal places, returning as string.
